versions.name: Camp Honokaia
versions.summary: The Aloha Council's Big Island Scout camp, a forested upland property between Honokaa and Waimea above Waipio Valley on the island of Hawaii, long serving as the home of Big Island Scouting for short-term camping and outdoor programs.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Aloha Council site and Big Island short-term camp event listings, which confirm the camp is currently open and hosting programs. The council board has authorized exploring a possible sale, lease, or partnership, but no decision has been made, so status is recorded as active. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, Aloha Council operation, and active status verified; future uncertain (board exploring disposition). camp_type/program_types classified conservatively from current short-term camp programming; features unsurveyed.
